balls.text: Full toss to finish, Aniket looks to carve it again. Top edges it to deep point
Yorker almost gets Klaasen off his feet, angled straight in. He tries to flick it, gets it off the inside half to deep fine
Chipped in the gap through extra cover. Very low full toss with a scrambled seam, close to the tramline, Klaasen bent his back knee to get underneath and drove it
Nortje misses the yorker and gets away with it. Fourth-stump knee-roll high full toss, Aniket was fully open and tried to carve it. Edged to deep third
Fifth-stump low fully, Aniket clears the front leg and bends to drive it with an open face through cover point
Quite the pull that. Sails over cow corner. Aniket made room and got followed by a pacy bac-of-lengther at the belly. Couldn't extend his arms but that didn't affect the power

No, he's looking for two. Gets it and gets the joint third fastest hundred in IPL history. Lid's off, stoic celebrations after that. Was a slower short ball outside off that was pulled without a follow-through towards deep midwicket
this time off a bouncer angling in. Another hit to the helmet, beat the pull and deflected away towards cover. No check though
Gets beaten. Slow and wide on the fuller side of length, Aniket looked to slash it over cover. Ball went under bat
Holes out to deep point. Pace-off, short and outside off. Kishan doesn't have the pace to work with on the cut, gets it off the upper-half of the bat.
Kishan gets hold of this full toss. It's lower and closer to the tramline, Kishan scythes it over point

Nasty. Kishan has top-edged a lap sweep right onto his head. It hit him on the side of the helmet, the head was turning towards square leg as the grille took the hit. Physio runs in right away, a few questions asked. He holds the head and then checks the helmet too. All good. Was a knee-roll high full toss outside off, Kishan got on one knee and tried to go just behind square
Beats the whip across the line with a low fully that goes under bat. Angled away through fourth. Russell tried seven yorkers in the over
Knee-roll high full toss down leg, helped fine. Narine was at short fine, went well to his right
Over the sightscreen. It's the slot ball he dined on earlier in the innings. This is on fourth, Klaasen takes a small forward stride and drives high and far. SRH bring up 250 with 14 balls to spare
Low fully on middle, flicked off the bottom to deep midwicket
Wide yorker, actually it's more fifth stump. Kishan goes back in the crease, lunges a touch and drives it flat over cover
Another yorker. Off-stump line, 135ks. Kishan made room but that was a bluff, he couldn't do much with it in the end Nudges to the leg side
Perfect yorker to start... but Russell has overstepped. Over the line. Klaasen jammed that to long-on
Wide on a length, cut with the spin to long-off
Yorker on middle and leg, short-arm whip along the ground to long-on's right
Klaasen starts making room, so Varun goes down leg too. Touch too wide as Klaasen stopped late, he let go after shaping to flick
Second pulled six of the over. Not as short but still sits up to the top of the stumps, Klaasen is deep in the crease and deposits it 73 metres over midwicket
Wide on a length again, smeared to the bowler's left. Half-stopped
Varun aims for the tramline, lands it on a length and angles it away. Klaasen belts it off the bottom, gets it to long-off on the bounce
Angle doesn't matter when it's that short. Sits up over off,  Klaasen stays in the crease while getting his weight back. Pulls over midwicket
Nortje can't end the over well. Low fully on leg, picked up over forward square leg. 69-metre six.
Essentially a free hit. Wide and full with no one in front of deep point. Not close to the tramline, so Kishan's easily able to drive it with a horizontal bat over cover
Full ball well down leg, goes past the attempted whip that Kishan wanted to get fine
Smart from Nortje but QDK misfields. Has to run back close to the boundary to concede two byes. Kishan made room early, so Nortje went out of his reach with a full ball around fifth
Bumper, very likely with the field. Kishan ducks while trying to pull, misses
Nortje goes wide and full, Klaasen stands still and scythes it aerially. Gets it to deep-backward point
Wide yorker. Jammed straight to Harshit at cover, Kishan takes off for a tight single. No direct hit at the non-striker's, might've made it even if it had hit
Wide on a length, caressed to deep cover
Full on off, worked to long-on
Wide from around the wicket, but it makes no difference to Klaasen. He has an open stance, extends his arms and belts it over wide long-off. 200 up in the 15th for SRH
Just over deep square leg, he was on the ropes and didn't bother jumping. Was a length ball just over the knee-roll that Klaasen slog swept. Just 65 metres but enough
Makes room and gets followed by a 94ks length ball that looked slow. Klaasen looks to slog it over long-on, inside edges to short fine. Varun there, misfields
Length on fourth, flat, worked off the back foot to deep square leg
Fullish on the pads, flicked to deep midwicket
Yorker down leg, Kishan looks to whip it fine. Misses
Wide on a back of length, cut to deep cover. Looked like a legcutter, 122ks
Looks to angle it away again, sixth-stump line, on a short length, this is given wide on height. Let go again
Goes for the wide yorker but the angle's too sharp. It landed outside the line and finished well outside. Let go
Ramandeep comes in from deep midwicket, can only get it on the bounce. Was a short ball at chest-height, Kishan spliced the pull
Vaibhav follows him effectively. Bowls it on the boot with Kishan not far to the wide-line. Ball beats the flick and goes off the shoe to short fine
Bouncer at 127ks is deemed wide. It landed around off and finished over leg, Kishan made room before leaving it
Cuts through third. There was short third and backward point, this went to the latter's right. Was a cross-seamer on a length, angled in towards fourth. Didn't bounce as much
Wide yorker, Klaasen opens the face without checking the shot. Goes on the bounce to deep-backward point
Full and slow from over the wicket, pushed from off stump to cover with a big forward stride
Fullish on middle and leg, flicked to midwicket. 90ks

Long-off takes it, Head has to go. Front-of-hand stock ball from Narine, landed on the fuller side of length at fifth before spinning further away. Head tried to launch it over extra, got it to Russell, who was on the boundary
A leave! Head might've thought it was wide at first. It was close to the line but in.
Head makes room now, slashes and misses. The fullish ball at 89ks looked slow and went with the angle
Makes a lot of room early, Narine follows him with a slow length ball spinning in towards the knee-roll. Flicked to deep square leg
Wide on a length, 136ks, guided to deep cover
Change of length. Beats bat for a change. Short ball at 141ks doesn't rise much, Klaasen looks to cut hard and misses
Towering six over long-on to bring up fifty. Gets there with another slot ball. This was a touch wide too, Klaasen stood in the crease, extended his arms and swung freely
Full toss. Even better for Klaasen. His back foot went across to fourth early, this cross-seamer came at shin-height. Klaasen, standing somewhat side-on, biffs it over midwicket
Klaasen's getting a slot-ball buffet, and he's repeatedly whacking it over the bowler. This was a cross-seamer on fifth, Klaasen got to off stump and drove through the line. One-bounce four
He goes wide yorker, 141ks. Head clears the front leg which limits his access, he literally jams the bat on the ball and it rolls towards point
Very low full toss on fifth, Head looks to guide it through cover. Inside edges to long-on
Another forehand, this time from Head. Beats long-on to the right. Was a back of lengther that was slow off the pitch, Head reached out and heaved at it with a flat bat
Boot-high low full toss on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Three slot balls in a row, two boundaries downtown. This clears it with ease, 78-metre six. Klaasen didn't have to move his feet
And again, a touch wider this time. Head looks to muscle it slightly across the line and toes it to long-off
Slot ball, a touch of width and Head pumps it over the bowler's head
Poor delivery and four more for Klaasen as Varun goes for 20 off that over. Short, very flat and Klaasen flat-bats this over the bowler's head.
Darted in short and wide outside off, he misses the cut
Fuller right in the slot outside off for Head who tonks this straight over the bowler's head for a four
Dragged down outside off, he stays back and hammers the pull to the right of deep midwicket. The ball falls just short of the ropes
Flatter and shorter outside off, he cuts this to deep point
Has to reach for it, does that and sends it downtown for six more. Slower outside off, he backs away and times this with some power
Flatter but well outside off, called a wide
Short and wide, he stays back and cuts to deep cover
Misfield and they get two. Flatter turning away from Head who punches this to the right of Rahane who dives over the ball
Darted in just outside off, he stays back and punches this to long-off
Ah, the deft touch. Flatter length ball on off stump, he gets down on one knee and laps this fine for four
Flatter on middle and leg, he clips this to short midwicket
Length ball turning back into Klaasen and that's terrific running from the duo. Klaasen works this to the left of deep midwicket where Arora is a little slow, which these two realise
Darted in at 99kph outside off, he chops this towards point as SRH collect 15 off Varun's first over.
Klaasen gets into the six-act. Marginally short turning into Klaasen, who rocks back and smacks the pull over deep square leg
Flatter on the stumps, he eases this to long-on
Flatter and shorter outside off, he looks for a cut but misses. Was there a bit of a nick? De Kock did not gather it properly.
A third half-century in IPL 2025 for Head. Takes 26 balls to get there. Dragged down on off stump, turning away from Head. He rocks back and hammers him over deep midwicket for a huge six
Spins big but waay outside the tramline outside off. Called a wide
Flatter down leg, he ticks this fine and to deep backward square leg where Nortje does the mopping up
Flatter on middle stump, he works this to deep backward square leg to get off the mark

A hint of turn and Narine has his revenge. On a length turning away from Abhishek outside off. He goes for a cross-batted strike, does not get his timing on point and Rinku takes a relatively comfortable catch at deep midwicket.
What timing! Man, how's that travelled all the way? Googly outside off, one hand comes off the bat but he still carves this over deep extra cover
Goes big, goes six! Six no. 100 for Abhishek in the IPL Flatter on the stumps, he heaves it away over wide long-on
Stifle short outside off, he stays back and cuts to deep point
Fuller in length turning away from Head. Think that was in his slot, but he gets beaten by the turn trying another big hit down the ground
Nails the yorker as Head backs away and squeezes this to short midwicket. SRH finish with 79 in the powerplay
On a length on leg stump, he works this to deep backward square leg for a run
Banged in short into his body, he splices his pull towards deep backward square leg. Falls well short of the fielder
BANG! In the slot on the stumps, Head clears his front foot again and hammers this over mid-off. Such is his power and timing that the ball clears the fence with ease
Four Leg-byes. They all count. On pace full ball outside off. He clears his front leg looking for an across the line swipe. Nutmegs himself and still gets runs for his team
Slower back of a length ball outside leg stump. Head is standing outside leg and looks to swing this away over fine leg. But he is done in by the lack of pace and rapped on the thigh pad
Not called wide and Abhishek does not review. Nortje goes full and very wide outside off. Touch and go on the tramline and the umpire goes with the bowler
Gets enough bat and gets four more. Back of  a hand slower ball, was the short ball outside off. He pulls, not off the middle, but places it in the gap to the left of mid-on
Oh, what a shot! Another attempted yorker goes wrong. Shin-high full toss on the stumps, he backs away and carves this over covers with an open face of the bat
Low full toss on leg stump, he gets the front foot out of the way but can't get underneath that. Miscues to long-on
Lands the yorker on middle, he jams this to short midwicket
Fullish in length on leg stump, he shuffles in his crease and drives firmly to mid-off.
Oh, wow. Full and waaaay outside off, would have been a wide in a Test match
Slower good length ball outside off, Abhishek punches to deep cover
Smacks him in the midriff. Was the slower offcutter outside leg. He is leg side of the ball and looks to heave across the line. Is too early into his shot
Oof! Blink and you'll miss it. That was bowled at 145kph on the fuller side on off and middle. He takes his front foot out of the way and carves it over point. SRH's fifty is up in 3.4 overs.
Slower offcutter outside off, Head was looking to send that out of the ground again, only manages a thick inside-edge onto pad
Pace-off, but that doesn't bother Head. Floats up the length ball right in Head's slot on middle. He brings out the full swing of the bat and sends it straight over the bowler's head
Wayward start and Head has four more. A gift first up and Head accepts this with glee. Was a length ball on his pad, he flicks this past short fine leg
A dot to finish. He jumps down and gives himself room. Arora follows him aiming for his pad. Abhishek toe-ends to mid-off
Fuller outside off, he backs away but can only dig this to mid-off.
Going, going, gone! Oh, Travishek are switched on, alright. On a length on off stump, he plays with the perfect straight back over mid-on and eventually over the ropes.
Heaved away and gets two more. On a length on leg stump, rather just outside. He gets this to Nortje at deep backward square leg who misfields a touch with the slide
PUMPED! On a length angling away from Head, but the width was key. He steps out of the way and thrashes him through covers
Flicked well, flicked for six. Length ball on head's pads, how is already leg side of the ball. He picks this up with minimum of fuss over deep backward square leg
Slower back of a length ball outside off. Abhishek pre-empts and moves outside leg stump only to see the ball well outside off. Can't do anything with that, laves it alone

Gets enough power to clear covers and get it to the boundary. He shimmies down the track and backs away as well. Nortje follows him, but Abhishek goes through with his chip over covers. One hand off the bat but he still generates enough power.
Oops! Too high, five wides. Banged in short well outside off and the ball just takes off. De Kock had no chance
Sliced straight over the bowler's head but gets four.  On a length just outside off, he does not get a clean connection but had placed it so well
Ooh, another shortish delivery but this kept low. On middle and leg at 148kph that strikes Head's thigh pad as he misses the pull
WALLOP! The first of the night and it's gigantic! Back of a length ball at 142kph on middle. Head gets into position nice and early and sends the pull soaring over deep backward square leg
Hard length to start off on off stump. He stays leg side of the ball, is up on his toes as he defends back to the bowler
Lovely start. Shimmies down the track to the length ball just around off stump as Abhishek pushes back to the bowler
Tightens the line so well. Starts the ball outside leg and with the movement gets it on leg stump. Abhishek can only defend back to the bowler
Angles the length ball just outside off stump, he opens the face of the bat and runs this past backward point for a run
On a good length on middle and leg, worked to short midwicket
On a length shaping from Head just outside off, he defends to covers
Off the mark with a runs. Hint of movement away from Abhishek outside off, he drives crisply and on the up to the left of deep point
Malinga bobbles it but the ball pops up closeby, he dives forward and takes it to end the game. Was a wide, full ball that Harshit tried to slash after making room. Got it off the bottom of the bat
Pace-on bouncer over middle hurries him on the pull
Big appeal for caught behind. Not given. SRH review. 138ks full ball outside off. Harshit cleared the front foot and looked to go over cover. Replay shows it went below the bottom edge.
Another slower bouncer. Very short, over leg stump. Harshit went more for the hook this time
Sits up and it's pulled to the right of long-on. Slower bouncer outside off, Harshit coils back and goes upright to middle it
Just over the stumps. Another slower one on a fullish length, beat Harshit's slog sweep
Massive swipe. Beaten. Slower bouncer over fourth, Norje went for the pull

Good shout for lbw, not given. Nvm, Unadkat hits the non-striker's stumps, so there's a run-out appeal too. Sent upstairs. Vaibhav was a touch late to take off, he would've made it had he slid his bat in. The right foot was past the crease but hovering in the air as the ball hit. He was holding his bat with both hands. Was a fullish ball around off that beat the inside edge to hit pad after beating the straight-bat block. Bravo jerked back and hid his face going 'what's that'
Top-edged pull taken at deep midwicket. Yet another slower bouncer, angling in. Finished fifth stump, around shoulder height. Manish gave it his all, got it off the bottom-half
Makes room and looks to cut the slower bouncer. Misses
Wide on a length, slashed to long-off. Klaasen fumbles but it won't cost him

Slower bouncer into the body this time. Pulled softly towards midwicket, Harshal chases, slides and throws in one motion. Sharp throw but too quick for the fielder at the stumps. Overthrows brings up the fifty stand
Very short slower bouncer lands well outside off, bounces over the batter who lets it go
Belts it. On the bounce to long-off. Shortish ball at the off-side tramline
Overpitched, launched over long-off this time. 120ks, at the stumps, Harshit's front foot is deep in the crease, in front of middle, back leg out the way and the drive is clean.
And again. Back of length through fifth, a bit of spin in. Harshit looking for even bounce again, swings in vain
Another slower one to beat the horizontal-bat shot. A pull this time, from well outside off. Kept real low
Spongy bounce off the slower bouncer beats the cut
Over long-on again. Tis is more bottom hand and bottom-hand heavy. Pandey crouches a bit and times it perfectly again
And another. Straight of long-on. Missed yorker ends up being a slot ball on leg. Hit 84 metres far
Fuller side of length at the stumps, Harshit makes room and swipes it to long-on. On the bounce
Slower bouncer doesn't rise much, is pulled to deep midwicket
Overpitched, muscled over long-on. Lots of these tonight. Batter clearing the front foot and driving a middle stump ball with a flourish
Hit on the flank. Shortish ball seamed in and skidded through to hurry Harshit on the flick. That'll sting
Slog swept hard and flat to deep midwicket. Full and tossed up on middle
Makes room and slaps it over the infield at cover

Harshal and Abhinav are close to the cow-corner boundary, the former drops it and it pops over the boundary. A bit of miscommunication. In the end, an attempt for a high catch bursts through the hands. Was a slog sweep that went high
Clears the front leg and clatters it over the bowler. Overpitched on middle there
Length on leg, beaten on the inside edge as he looks to defend straight. Hit on the pad
Overpitched on off, thumped through cover
Full outside off, 97ks, driven to deep cover
Two sixes, and then leg stump's decked. Quicker stock ball angles in, lands on a length around leg and straightens. Ramandeep looks to defend the line, gets beaten by spin
Even better, more of an off-drive this time. Mostly bottom hand, on one knee again
Straight six. Ramandeep gets on one knee and tonks it from fourth stump off a length
Goes leg side of the ball to slap it to deep point
Makes room and drives the full ball back to the bowler
Around a yorker length, jammed to midwicket
Knee-roll high full toss on middle, Pandey's beside the line and whips it to deep midwicket
Short and slow, Pandey makes room and forehands it to mid-off. Not middled
Back of length, slightly down leg. Ramandeep goes across and flicks to deep square leg
Slower one, pulled to deep midwicket. 107ks, dipped was on the lower side from a back of length. Raghuvanshi was early on the pull, bottom hand came off too. Raghuvanshi's season ends with 294 runs
Keeps low and cuts him in half. 138ks on a length, came back and went through fourth stump. Raghuvanshi looked to punch straight before digging the bat low. Misses
97ks length ball on fourth, cut back onto pad. Rolls to point
Overpitched, pumped straight of long-on. At the stumps, Pandey got beside the line and drove with full follow-through
Length on leg, flicked to deep square leg
Dances down and drives on the up to cover point's right. 100ks
Length on middle, punched to the bowler
Goes across and sweeps the full ball to deep square leg. 100ks
Touch short, pulled to the left of deep midwicket. One-bounce four
Length outside off, patted to cover point. 90ks
Length on leg, flicked off the back foot towards square leg
Beaten on the pull, the length ball down leg hits above the knee roll
Length outside off, cut to point
Fullish on leg, looks to defend straight. Inside edges it to square leg
Dances down to work it off the front foot to long-on
Full on middle, makes room and drives to long-off
Overpitched outside off, driven to the left of cover who doesn't get down in time
Similar ball, flicked off the back foot to long-on
Length on off, 94ks, a bit of turn away, worked towards midwicket
Fullish on middle, 95ks, defended to the bowler's left
Slower offcutter outside off, he opens the face of the bat and runs this to deep third
Low full toss on middle and leg, he pushes to long-on
Short and wide, he cuts this to deep point
Slower short ball outside off, but that is too high
On a good length outside off, he pushes to long-off
Length ball outside off, he gets this to backward point
Short and wide, he eyes a cut but misses

Russell goes! For a first ball duck. He's actually walked before the umpire could even raise his finger. Length ball that pitches on middle and turns away from Russell. He is rooted the crease and is trapped bang in front of the stumps. That would have missed off, missed leg and thudded into middle stump

Pummeled straight into the hands of deep midwicket. Oh, Rinku will be gutted there. Really hit that hard, but got no elevation whatsoever. Dragged down on the stumps, he tocks back and smokes the pull. Reddy didn't have to move an inch
Picks this up and plonks it over deep midwicketDarted in on middle and leg, Rinku clears his front  leg, bends down on one knee and deposits it miles
Angles this across the batter outside off, he slices this to point
Stifle short outside off, he stays back and cuts this to the right of deep point for a couple of runs
Flatter outside off, that kept a touch low as Rinku mises
Slower yorker on off stump, he jams this to point

De Kock's day and tournament is done. Was that too high? The umpires want to check. On-pace full toss outside off stump. That looked high, but is it high enough especially with the technology kicking in is the question. De Kock hacked that straight down Abhinav Manohar's throat at deep midwicket. Got no timing on that whatsoever did de Kock despite hitting it to the short side. It is taking some time to check the height on this. De Kock is halfway back to the dugout. The next batter has been standing around the boundary rope for a while. We wait. Finally, finally we have the graphic. And as suspected, it is a fair delivery. De Kock's waist is at 1m, and the ball arrived at 0.87m. De Kock departs and his tournament ends in disappointing fashion.
Too high? Nope.  Slower bouncer on leg stump, de Kock lets that go.
On-pace knee-high full toss on off stump. He pushes this to long-on
Slower offcutter angling away from de Kock who looks to muscle this away across the line, cue-ends it to extra cover
Huge appeal for lbw first up, but think that pitched outside leg. Full on leg stump, de Kock misses the flick and is rapped on the pad. That pitched way outside leg stump

Ooh, the change of pace almost gets Unadkat another wicket. Angles the slower offcutter on a good length area landing it on off stump and turning it away. Raghuvanshi runs down the track and is lucky to not get an edge
Slower offcutter on the fuller side outside off, he checks his drives towards extra cover
Starts off with a high-quality cover drive.  On a length on pace just outside off. He prods forward and laces the drive to the left of mid-off

Straight up, straight up and that is safely held by Abhishek at extra cover. Slower offcutter that turns away from Rahane. He looks to go across the line, but only manages to balloon it up. Unadkat has his second wicket of the evening.
Fuller and on pace outside off, he lays into the drive and sends it screaming to the right of point
Short ball banged into the pitch, de Kock dances down the track and pulls to deep midwicket

Stifle appeal for lbw, not given. And then Rahane would have been out had Aniket hit the stumps direct. So much has happened there. Slower offcutter that grips and spins back into Rahane. He eyes a pull and misses with the ball lobbing towards backward point. He fires a direct throw with Rahane not even in the frame. Misses. Then, Cummins says he wants to review. No bat for sure, think the height will be the question here. And, indeed that was bouncing over the middle and leg stump.
Cummins drops a tough catch running.  On a length on the stumps, Rahane looks to go downtown but ends up spooning it straight up. Cummins backtracks from mid-off, but can't lay a finger on the ball.
Slower back of a length ball around off stump, Rahane heaves this away around the deep midwicket area for four more
UP AND OVER! Back of a length ball on pace outside off, he goes over extra cover with a slight open face of the bat
On a length outside off, he pushes towards mid-off
Good length ball to start off outside off, he cuts to point where NKR has a shy at the stumps at the non-strikes's end. Misses, but Rahane was in nevertheless
Backs away to the slower offcutter but can only mistime his heave to short midwicket

Oh, that would have been out with a direct hit. And looks like Unadkat has hurt his shoulder as well while diving. Slower offcutter on off stump. He defends close to the pitch and is called for a run by Rahane. Unadkat though is quick in his followthrough. Bends down and has a shy at the stumps with a flick. In doing that he lands awkwardly on his bowling shoulders. Grimaces in pain but is quickly up. Seems ok to continue. Rahane was definitely a goner had that hit
Fullish in length just outside off, he mistimes to mid-off and sets off

You miss, I hit... Narine misses and Unadkat does hit. Slower offcutter at 100.6kph that was on a good length on leg stump. Narine backs away and eyes a cross-batted swipe. He misses and Unadkat hits leg stump.
Edged and four more. Full in length on middle and leg stump. He was aiming to on-side, gets a thick outside edge that flies to the right of short third
Shin-high full toss on his pad, de Kock works this off the toe-end towards the short midwicket area
Backs away, gets four. Low full toss outside off stump, he slices this over point
Full right on the tramline outside off. Narine backing away was nowhere close. Not called a wide
Slower bouncer called a wide. Was just around off stump and Narine let it go. Cummins asks Kishan whether that was too high. Kishan asks him to not go for the review
Full outside off, he tries to squeeze it out, but misses

Whisked away for six more. Narine backs away big time but Cummins follows him, cramping him for room. Narine swivels and pulls, not off the middle of the bat. But that is the short side of the ground which helped him clear the fence.
Angles the length ball away from Narine outside off. He drives but right of the toe-end of the bat to extra cover
Sharp length ball on middle and leg stump, he flays it away off the inside half of the bat to deep backward square leg
Huge swing and a miss. Slower offcutter that pitches on leg stump and turns into Narine. He is well outside leg stump and a massive swipe only to connect at thin air
Slower bouncer and he sways outside the line. Was the offcutter dug into the surface cutting back into Narine who was backing away
Slower good length ball on off and middle, he works this towards midwicket for a run
Shin-high full toss on middle stump, he toe-ends this over the bowler's head for a run

Outside edge that flies over short third. Full on off stump, he backs away, clears his front leg and has a huge swing. The ball catches the edge and his bat swing means it will always clear the in-field
Angles the length ball around off stump, de Kock pushes to the off side and sets off

Oh, what a shot to finish the over! Narine backs away and backs away big time. Cummins follows him, cramping him for room. Narine still manages to flick this away and gets enough power to clear deep midwicket.
